query: Intel Xeon server CPU revenue trend latest quarter
normalized: cpu intel quarter revenue server trend xeon

output.content:
Intel does not separately disclose **Xeon server-CPU revenue**; the closest reported measure is Data Center and AI (DCAI) revenue, which also includes other data-center and AI products and, since Q1 2025, incorporates part of the former Network and Edge Group reporting. [[1]]

**Latest reported quarter: Q2 2026 (ended June 27, 2026).** DCAI revenue was **$6.262 billion**, up **59% year over year**. [[2]]

**Trend:** DCAI revenue rose from **$3.9 billion in Q2 2025**, to **$4.1 billion in Q3**, **$4.7 billion in Q4**, **$5.1 billion in Q1 2026**, and **$6.3 billion in Q2 2026**. [[1]] [[3]] [[4]] [[5]] [[2]] 

That means the latest quarter increased by roughly **$1.16 billion, or 23% sequentially**, from Q1 2026’s $5.1 billion, following a steady recovery through late 2025 and an acceleration in Q2 2026. [[5]] [[2]] 

The key takeaway is that Intel’s server/data-center business proxy has expanded by about **61% over four quarters** from Q2 2025 to Q2 2026, although this should not be characterized as a pure Xeon revenue series because of the DCAI segment’s broader product scope and the reporting reorganization. [[1]] [[2]]
